summary: ANSWERFIER Q&A + QOTD FEATURE VERIFIED END-TO-END (backend + UI). Backend: 22 new pytest tests added to /app/backend/tests/test_answerfier.py covering: (a) GET /api/answerfier requires auth, returns {qotd, questions, categories} with qotd.category=='Question of the Day', is_qotd=true, user_id=null, is_author=false; no _id leakage; categories list excludes 'Question of the Day' and includes seeded General/Craft & Making/Science/Life & Advice. (b) QOTD idempotency: two consecutive GETs on same UTC day return same qotd.id/title, qotd_date == today.isoformat(); /api/answerfier/qotd matches board's qotd. (c) QOTD pool: import-level assertion that _QOTD_POOL has 1476 unique entries (12 templates x 123 topics) and _qotd_text_for over the first 1000 days yields 1000 unique strings — proves no-repeat within a 1000-day window. (d) POST /api/answerfier/questions authored by caller with correct display_name/user_id, category preserved; title <5 chars => 422; bogus category => coerced to 'General'; 'Question of the Day' category => coerced to 'General'. (e) GET /api/answerfier/questions/{id} returns is_author correctly, answers sorted best-first then by upvotes (verified on seed q1: best a2 first with upvotes=34, then a1 with 12); 404 for unknown id. (f) POST /api/answerfier/questions/{id}/answers appends answer as caller (author/user_id/upvotes=0/voted=false/is_best=false, no _id); 404 for unknown question. (g) POST /api/answerfier/answers/{id}/vote toggles idempotently (up +1 then back to previous count); 404 for unknown answer. (h) POST /api/answerfier/questions/{id}/best: only asker allowed (other user gets 403), toggling same answer_id clears best_answer_id, QOTD (user_id=None) cannot have best set — any caller gets 403. (i) QOTD is answerable via its question id — POST answers works. (j) All write endpoints and board require Bearer token (401/403 for anon). Full pytest suite: 107/107 PASS in 15.67s (85 previous + 22 new answerfier). Frontend E2E via Playwright (mobile 375x667): registered fresh users, verified /district/answerfier — 5 feature-<name> rows present (feature-New Questions, feature-Popular Questions, feature-Trending Questions, feature-Unanswered Questions, feature-Categories) + 'Enter Answerfier' opens /answerfier; tapping feature-Unanswered Questions routes to /answerfier?filter=unanswered. On /answerfier hub: qotd-card rendered with brass gradient + today's QOTD title, sort-new/popular/trending/unanswered chips + cat-all + ask-question-btn all present. Ask flow: tapped ask-question-btn -> /answerfier/new-question -> filled nq-title/nq-body/nq-cat-Technology -> nq-submit -> router.replace to /answerfier/question/<new_id>. Answering: logged in as second user, added answer via answer-input+answer-send, answer visible in list, 1 answer-vote element and 0 answer-best elements (correctly hidden for non-asker). Voted twice (toggle no error). Logged back in as asker: 1 answer-best element visible; tap surfaces 'Best answer' badge; toggle clears it. Roundtable regression: /district/roundtable still has feature-Create Community / feature-Browse Communities / feature-Joined Communities (rename rt-feature-* -> feature-* holds).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:453-460 (_QOTD_POOL / _qotd_text_for): pool size 12*123 = 1476 unique entries, fixed-seed shuffle (Random(20260101)) so deterministic across processes/days; index = (day - epoch).days % len(pool) — cycle length 1476 >> 1000, so no repeat in any 1000-day window. Correct.

server.py:935-959 (_ensure_qotd): read-then-insert with try/except catches unique-index race on qotd_date and re-reads existing. Combined with unique sparse index on qotd_date (server.py:511) this guarantees exactly-one QOTD per calendar date across concurrent callers — idempotent as required.

server.py:962-974 (af_board): excludes is_qotd docs from the questions list (correct — QOTD lives in `qotd`), categories dynamically extended by user-created categories but never re-adds 'Question of the Day' (already stripped) — matches spec.

server.py:982-997 (af_create_question): category coerced to 'General' if not in AF_CATEGORIES or if == 'Question of the Day' — prevents users from spoofing the QOTD category. Title min_length=5 enforced by Pydantic (422).
server.py:1000-1016 (af_question_detail): answers.sort key is (not is_best, -upvotes, created_at) — best pinned first, then upvote-desc, ties broken by oldest-first. Matches spec.

server.py:1040-1052 (af_set_best): asker check `q.user_id != user.id` — for QOTD user_id is None, so any caller mismatches -> 403 (spec: QOTD cannot have best set). Toggle logic: set best to null if same answer already best.

server.py:1055-1072 (af_vote_answer): per-user (user_id, answer_id) doc in af_answer_votes; upvotes clamped >=0 via max(0, ...); toggle-idempotent. No unique index but delete_one/insert_one keeps state consistent.
frontend/src/api/client.ts: af* methods (afBoard/afQotd/afQuestion/afCreateQuestion/afAddAnswer/afVoteAnswer/afSetBest) return typed Question/Answer/AnswerfierBoard — matches backend payloads.

frontend/app/answerfier/index.tsx: sort chips derive initial value from ?filter=<key>; visible list filters by category and applies client-side sort for popular/trending; 'unanswered' returns list.filter(answer_count===0). QOTD is a Pressable card that navigates to /answerfier/question/<qotd.id> — user can then answer it (matches backend behaviour).

frontend/app/answerfier/question/[id].tsx: 'Mark best' Pressable is rendered only when question.is_author === true (via backend-computed flag), so a non-asker never sees the button — matches 403 backend rule.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 district feature testIDs + Enter button + hub qotd/sort/cat testIDs + ask flow + answer flow + vote + best-answer toggle + roundtable regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Answerfier Q&A + QOTD is fully verified. Endpoints: GET /api/answerfier, GET /api/answerfier/qotd, POST /api/answerfier/questions, GET /api/answerfier/questions/{id}, POST /api/answerfier/questions/{id}/answers, POST /api/answerfier/questions/{id}/best, POST /api/answerfier/answers/{id}/vote — all require Bearer. QOTD pool _QOTD_POOL in server.py has exactly 1476 unique entries; _qotd_text_for(day) uses fixed seed shuffle so is deterministic across processes. QOTD document is stored in af_questions with is_qotd=True + qotd_date=YYYY-MM-DD (unique sparse index). District feature chip testIDs on both /district/answerfier and /district/roundtable are now `feature-<label>` (renamed from rt-feature-*). Test file uses `-n 2 --dist loadscope` (see /app/backend/pytest.ini) — dependent tests must share state via module-scoped fixtures (created_question, created_answer) because pytest globals don't cross xdist workers.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The QOTD non-repeat property was verified two ways: (1) direct assertion that len(set(_QOTD_POOL)) == 1476 (>1000) so any consecutive-day slice of length <=1476 has no duplicates, (2) property test computing _qotd_text_for over 1000 consecutive days starting at the epoch and asserting all outputs are unique. Best-answer 403 for QOTD works because QOTD's user_id is None and the asker check `q.user_id != current_user_id` is always True for authenticated users (whose ids are non-null UUIDs).
